why: Degree of freedom: while a critical service is down, every agent's landing rights narrow to repairing it. The incidents are not probed here a second time (AGENTS.md section 6): they are the open issues the cloud drill (estate-homes-drill.yml -> bin/idp-estate-homes) files every 30 minutes and closes when the lane is back. bin/dof-gate, a needs of ci-success (the ruleset's required context), refuses every commit that does not carry `Genesis-Resolves: <failing id>` and stay inside that id's repairScope.

llm-router.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] llm-router incident

otto.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] otto incident

estate-doors.repairProtocol: issue body of the open [lane] estate-doors incident

dof-probe.repairProtocol: the gate could not read the incident list: fix the gate

safeWorkScope.why: A broken service constrains operations that DEPEND on it, not the whole estate. Paths outside every substrate glob depend on no critical service, so they keep an authorised path during an outage. This is the deadlock breaker: without it, independent work has no admissible route and the estate cannot recover by building anything except a repair.
safeWorkScope.rule: a commit whose every changed path is outside substrateScope is admitted without a Genesis-Resolves trailer
